# glinet_fan_status (Data Source)

Get the status of the fan of the router (`fan.get_status`). The values change while the router runs. Only a router with a fan (`hardware_feature.fan` of `system.get_info`) has a fan status; the result on other routers is not known. To set the temperature at which the fan starts, use `glinet_fan`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_fan_status" "fan" {}

output "fan_speed" {
  value = data.glinet_fan_status.fan.speed
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `running` (Boolean) Whether the fan turns (`status`).
- `speed` (Number) Speed of the fan in RPM (`speed`).
